verdict.rationale: Sierra offers an Agent SDK for writing customer journeys as code within normal development workflows, and agents can be published via CI/CD, which implies some programmatic control. However, nothing in the evidence documents a public API for driving the platform itself, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API reference, a published OpenAPI spec, API coverage of Studio/Explorer/Insights operations, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
